definitions.gloss: senility, physical decline due to old age, death from old age
definitions.explanation: The gradual deterioration of bodily functions due to advanced age. In Japanese medical and legal contexts, it is used as an official cause of death when no specific disease is identified.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老衰|ろうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather passed away from old age.

examples.japanese: ⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老衰|ろうすい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The cause of death was diagnosed as senility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢化|こうれいか}→高齢化：04808_koureika⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、{老衰|ろうすい}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As society continues to age, deaths from old age are increasing.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, {老衰|ろうすい} is an officially recognized cause of death on death certificates, used when an elderly person dies of natural causes without a specific identifiable disease. It has become one of the leading causes of death as Japan's population ages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {老衰|ろうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなる→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧: to die of old age
- {老衰|ろうすい}⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧: death from old age
- ⟦{死因|しいん}→死因：13224_shiin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{老衰|ろうすい}: cause of death is senility
- {老衰|ろうすい}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{死亡|しぼう}→死亡：03198_shibou⟧: death due to old age
